Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select donor_decision_code
 into :s_current_cue
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :s_current_cue = 'A'
 then
 :s_current_cue_desc := 'Ambiguous';
 end if;
 if :s_current_cue = 'S'
 then
 :s_current_cue_desc := 'Autologous';
 end if;
 if :s_current_cue = 'T'
 then
 :s_current_cue_desc := 'Therapeutic';
 end if;
 if :s_current_cue = 'O'
 then
 :s_current_cue_desc := 'No Cue';
 end if;
 if :s_current_cue = 'N'
 then
 :s_current_cue_desc := 'NFT';
 end if;
 if :s_current_cue = 'Y'
 then
 :s_current_cue_desc := 'OK';
 end if;
 go_block('unit_dd_overrides');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW'
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0164');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_override_code_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'OVERR'
 and code = :override_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'A'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Ambiguous';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'S'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Autologous';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'Therapeutic';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'O'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'No Cue';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'N'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'NFT';
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'Y'
 then
 :s_donor_decision_code_desc := 'OK';
 end if;
 if :unit_dd_overrides.note_id is not null
 then
 :s_note := 'X';
 end if;
end;
